slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental report on the October 2016 APAI-CRVS monitoring round; per-country answers are not published. Mali appears only in the annex bands: digitization of the civil registration system under 35 per cent (with 20 other countries), legal framework 65-79, infrastructure and resources 50-64, planning and coordination 65-79, overall 50-64. A composite band, not a statement of how or where offices register.
